summary.text: Shelley B. Mayer is a Democratic member of the New York State Senate who has represented District 37 since 2018 and is running for re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines.
She previously served in the New York State Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Shelley Mayer holds a B.A. from the University of California, Los Angeles (1975) and a J.D. from the State University of New York at Buffalo School of Law (1979).

Her professional experience includes serving as assistant attorney general in the office of New York Attorney General Bob Abrams from 1982 to 1994, chief counsel to the New York State Senate Democrats from 2007 to 2011, and senior counsel in the National State Attorney General Program at Columbia Law School from 2011 to 2012.
Mayer represented Assembly District 93 from 2012 to 2013 and Assembly District 90 from 2013 to 2018, before succeeding George Latimer in the Senate in 2018.
